item.title: As Micron prepares to expand, Clay housing market heats up

item.title: Man indicted for sexually abusing children attended church in Watertown
item.description: 55-year-old James Yerdon has been indicted for the sexual abuse of two boys, one 11-years-old, and one 14. Both cases stretched from at least 2023 into 2025.

item.title: Syracuse teen charged in armed robbery attempt in Fairmount Wegmans parking lot
item.description: A 16-year-old Syracuse male was arrested for attempting to rob a 17-year-old with a loaded gun in the Fairmount Wegmans parking lot, and is now facing multiple felony charges.

item.description: DEWITT, N.Y. item.title: History-making gubernatorial ticket makes first public appearance in Syracuse
item.description: Governor Hochul and Adrienne Adams, the first all-female ticket in the history of New York State's gubernatorial races, spoke publicly together for the first time in Syracuse ahead of the State Democratic Convention.

item.title: Man arrested for hate crime graffiti in Town of Clay
item.description: Justin C. Wilson, 27, of Clay, was arrested and charged with Criminal Mischief in the Third Degree with Hate Crime Enhancement and Aggravated Harassment in the First Degree for spray-painting a swastika on a residential garage in Clay on Jan. 6.

item.title: Crews faced with slick conditions while fighting house fire on West Genesee Street
item.description: Four people were outside a house on West Genesee Street when firefighters arrived to battle a fire, one of whom was treated for injuries, and no firefighters were hurt in the process.
